meta.title: Inventory Atlas Lite — self-hosted inventory for physical items
meta.description: Inventory Atlas Lite is a small self-hosted inventory app: know what you own and where it is, with locations, containers, custom fields, photos, QR labels, checklists, and a dashboard — on your own server.
meta.ogTitle: Inventory Atlas Lite — know what you own and where it is
meta.ogDescription: A small self-hosted inventory app for physical items. Your server, your data.
meta.ogImageAlt: The Inventory Atlas Lite Dashboard with item totals, photo coverage, and charts.

hero.lead: Know what you own and where it is. A deliberately small inventory app that runs on your own server and keeps every item, field, and photo in a database you control.

sqlite.text: Items and photos in one file

noAccounts.text: Made for a trusted LAN or VPN

localFirst.text: AI and cloud backup are optional

hierarchy.title: Everything has a place
hierarchy.text: Model your home the way it really is. Items sit in locations, inside containers, inside other containers — and the Hierarchy shows the whole picture.
points: Location → container → item, nested as deep as you need.
Contained items show the location of their outermost container.
Browse a searchable tree or an interactive graph, by location or by category.
Move a whole selection into another container in one step.

items.title: Categories with fields that fit
items.text: Every category gets its own fields, so a drill can record its power source and a camera its lens mount, next to the details every item shares.
points: Text, number, date, and yes/no custom fields per category.
Condition grades, New or Used, purchase date and price, serial numbers.
Templates, Duplicate, and Batch Add from JSON for quick data entry.
Choose and sort the columns of the Items list, including custom fields.

photos-qr.title: See it, label it, scan it
photos-qr.text: Keep photos with each item and print QR labels for boxes and shelves. Scan a label with your phone to open the item right away.
points: Several photos per item, in your order, with the cover photo you choose.
QR labels on A4 sheets in three layouts, with the details you pick.
The in-app scanner reads labels with the camera or from an image, locally.
Optional local background removal for clean product photos.

find.title: Find it fast, check it off
find.text: Search names, descriptions, serial numbers, and custom field values, then filter by category and condition. Checklists make packing and audits routine.
points: Instant search and filters across the whole inventory.
Packing and Verification checklists with a phone-first run page.
Audit a container to confirm everything inside is still there.
Completed checks record when each item was last verified.

dashboard.title: A dashboard for your stuff — and optional AI
dashboard.text: See how big the inventory is, how well it is documented, and where things are. When you want help, AI can draft items and fields for you to review.
points: Totals, photo coverage, placement status, and recent additions.
Breakdowns by category, condition, and location.
AI Add Item drafts an item from a photo or a description — optional, off by default.
Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a local Ollama or LM Studio model.

install.title: Choose how to run it
install.text: Inventory Atlas Lite is self-hosted software, not a hosted service. Pick the path that fits your setup; the repository documentation has the full instructions.
install.note: There are no user accounts: keep Inventory Atlas Lite on a trusted home network or reach it through a VPN such as Tailscale.

release.title: GitHub Release
release.text: Every stable version is published with release notes, a checksummed source archive, and a Docker image.
release.label: Browse releases

docker.title: Docker
docker.text: Run the image from GitHub Container Registry with your data on a named volume.
docker.label: Docker instructions

proxmox.title: Proxmox VE
proxmox.text: One command on a Proxmox node creates an unprivileged LXC and installs the latest release.
proxmox.label: Proxmox guide

node.title: Node.js
node.text: Build and start it with Node.js on any machine you already run.
node.label: Manual setup

final.title: Start your inventory today
final.text: Install it on your own hardware, add the first few items, and find them again in seconds.
